topologyPolicy.decision: Use route groups for walked official route topology and connections for transfers between route entries.

routeGroupKinds.mainline: Primary continuous official section chain for the selected trail model.
routeGroupKinds.branch: Official alternate or side branch that can be hiked as trail, but should not be silently merged into the mainline.
routeGroupKinds.access: Official or strongly supported approach route to/from public transport, village, trailhead or another trail.
routeGroupKinds.connector: Walked link between route groups or nearby route sections where it is part of the trail model.

topologyPolicy.connectionsUse: Use connections.json-style records for non-section transfers or continuity records between sections: ferry, bus, road transfer, rowboat, short walk transfer, same-island continuity, or mode none for a known gap with no usable transfer geometry.
topologyPolicy.officialRowboatRule: If a rowboat crossing is an official route entry in its own right, model it as a section route with strong warnings. Otherwise model it as a rowboat connection or access/side metadata.

actions: Before runtime import, review data/research/candidate-trails/nordkalottleden/geometry/geometry-quality-report.json and decide endpoint/connector policy for sections 1, 2, 8, 11 and 12.
For normalization, use the generated official-source geometry artifacts as candidate route lines and keep Saarijarvi, source-boundary and Madam Bongos/Cunovuohppi gaps explicit.
Do not use OSM child relation 9517537 for section 12 geometry; it remains incomplete for Kautokeino and is superseded by the Turrutebasen artifact.

decisionsApplied.decision: Keep the researched 12-section model as the candidate mainline and represent Saarijärvi, Saraelv/Ovi Raishiin, Madam Bongos/Čunovuohppi and the section 6 source-boundary mismatch as explicit endpoint-zone/known-gap metadata.

connections.importPolicy: Do not invent a hut-yard connector; expose hut access only as endpoint/access metadata if supported.
Preserve the mixed-source boundary and review before creating any shared route graph node.
Do not draw a seamless line from Saraelv to Ovi Raishiin without separately sourced connector geometry.
Treat Madam Bongos/Čunovuohppi as legacy endpoint/access metadata, never as active lodging.

remainingGeometryWork: Review the section 6 source-boundary gap before creating runtime graph nodes.
Keep alternate whole-trail variants outside the 12-section model as a scope limitation.
